notes.title: ver. 1.03 Improved endings, visuals, bug fixes.
notes.content:
- Visuals for the final confrontation has been improved!

- Several endings have been changed. (new dialogues, maps, and visuals)

- New traditional save system.



Bug fixes:

- Now you can't escape the chase scene just by using the door at the beginning.

- Glitched save point has been removed.

- Dash isn't available from the beginning anymore.

- other minor bug fixes/typos etc.
